gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tai-th: Bushcraft strings its letters out wide, every curve drawn with no swell or thinning at all. Noto Sans Tai Tham follows with chalkboard-style lowercase that crowds the top line, its openings clearly visible, so extended text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tai-vi: Smooth as a pen-plotter line, with wide-set letters and almost no fuss between capitals and lowercase, Bushcraft leads the way. Noto Sans Tai Viet answers with short ascenders and a lofty x-height.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks slightly magnified even at modest sizes, with terminals that stop well away from the stem. And Bushcraft, with its closed, untapered letters, belongs up large in just a few words.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-tamil-: Bushcraft draws every stem, bowl and tail like a length of rope, closed and unvarying. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement offers round open forms like parentheses and a deep middle band, and that clash of closed against open is the strongest thing here.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-thai-l: Wide-spaced and wiry, all closed shapes. Noto Sans Thai Looped replies with spacious open terminals and big-bodied lowercase, and that closed-versus-open split is what makes the pair.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-yi: Bushcraft is built like rounded rod, one weight throughout, with closed letters spaced far apart. Noto Sans Yi is the better one for running text, its deep lowercase midsection and unlatched hooks giving each line room to open up.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-traditional: Expressive and a bit wiry, Bushcraft spaces its closed letters far apart. Noto Traditional Nushu follows with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut and bowls filling the line, which makes paragraphs feel friendly and unhurried.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-orienta: Bushcraft stretches its letters wide, closed and uniform, with capitals barely rising above the lowercase in height. Orienta reads easily, its counters opening like a cut reed.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-parkinsans: Artistic and wiry, Bushcraft closes every letter and spaces it wide. Parkinsans offers one stroke thickness throughout and wide-mouthed lowercase that stays crisp when shrunk, and that open-versus-closed difference is the strongest thing here.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-pt-sans-caption: Rope-stiff and widely spaced, Bushcraft keeps diagonals as heavy as its stems, with closed letters throughout. PT Sans Caption does the opposite job, its unclosed bowls and big-bodied lowercase inviting you along a line.
